In chamber music and in the string section of an orchestra it usually takes the bass or the tenor part, sometimes reinforced an octave below by the double bass. In the Baroque period it belonged to the continuo group, playing with organ, harpsichord, lute or theorbo. Today it is also heard in Chinese orchestras, in cello rock bands, on pop and rock recordings and in hip-hop and rhythm and blues performances; some instruments are adapted for Indian classical music.

The cello, in full violoncello, is a bowed instrument of the low middle register and belongs to the violin family, Hornbostel–Sachs 321.322-71. It usually has four strings tuned in fifths to C2, G2, D3 and A3, an octave below the viola; the body is supported on the floor by the endpin. The player is called a cellist, and the instrument can play solo or take the bass or tenor part in a string quartet, in the string section of an orchestra and in the Baroque continuo group, and it appears in line-ups such as the modern Chinese orchestra and cello rock bands.
提琴家族約1500年自腿式提琴家族分出，最早約1530年義大利繪畫已見三種尺寸。: The violin family separated from the family of instruments held on the leg around 1500, and Italian paintings of about 1530 already show three sizes. The cello did not evolve from the leg-held viol but coexisted with it for about two and a half centuries. Its direct ancestor is the bass violin, which Monteverdi called the bass instrument of the viol family played on the arm in Orfeo; this instrument is often called the 'large viola' and was about 77 to 80 centimetres long. Around 1700 Italian players made the cello current in northern Europe, while France kept the bass violin for about twenty years longer. Many surviving bass violins were cut down to the smaller Stradivarian pattern, and the size was standardised only around 1750.

A beginner can work from the twelve solo toccatas in the early tutor Principij da imparare a suonare il violoncello e con 12 Toccate a solo, starting with the tuning, a solo line and basic bowing.
琴身主要由雲杉木製作面板，背板與側板使用楓木或其他硬木；琴頸與指板採用烏木或楓木: The body has a soundboard mainly of spruce, with back and ribs of maple or another hardwood; the neck and fingerboard are of ebony or maple. The bow stick is usually of brazilwood and the hair comes from a horse's tail. The bridge, pegs and similar parts are of maple or another hardwood. The strings are of steel, nylon or gut. The endpin, added later, is generally of wood or metal and gives support.
